hero.title: Your law office, on your computer
hero.subtitle: Keep clients, cases, hearings and fees in one place. Legal Masr is a free desktop app for individual Egyptian lawyers, with Arabic-first screens and daily work that runs offline.
hero.note: Free. No subscription. No account required.

mock.ref: Client, hearings and documents in one record
mock.commentaryText: Record the hearing decision, add the next hearing and follow up on preparation.

features.title: Built for your daily practice
features.lead: Know what is due. Find the file. Follow up with confidence.

items.title: Keep each case together
items.desc: Bring the court reference, clients, opponents, hearing history and documents into one case record.

items.title: See hearings and follow-ups
items.desc: Review today’s hearings, upcoming dates and overdue tasks from Today and Agenda. Record a hearing decision and its next hearing together.

items.title: Find clients and powers of attorney
items.desc: Keep client details, related cases and powers of attorney connected. Search clients, cases and powers of attorney from one search field.

items.title: Follow fees and expenses
items.desc: Record agreed fees, payments and expenses. See what has been received and what remains due for a case or client.

items.title: Keep documents with their records
items.desc: Add managed copies of documents to a case, client or power of attorney, then open them in the appropriate app on your computer.

items.title: Back up and export your work
items.desc: Create an encrypted backup manually and save a separate copy. Export a case or all records as CSV files with documents when needed; exports are unencrypted.

guide.title: Start with one case
guide.lead: A clear place for each step of your work.

steps.title: Set up your app
steps.desc: Enter your name, choose a password and keep your recovery key somewhere safe.

steps.title: Add a client and case
steps.desc: Record the client, open a case and add the court details and related documents.

steps.title: Plan the next step
steps.desc: Add the hearing and preparation tasks, then check Today and Agenda as you work.

steps.title: Keep a separate backup
steps.desc: Create a backup in Settings → Backups and save a copy outside the app’s data folder.

local.title: Your case records stay on your computer
local.desc: The desktop app stores office records locally. It does not upload your client or case data to our servers. Visiting this website or downloading an installer connects to the hosting provider.
points: No mandatory account or cloud sync
An encrypted local database and manual encrypted backups
You choose when to export or share files

download.title: Public beta · v0.2.4
download.desc: Try a more organized working day.
download.note: Windows 10/11 x64 and Linux x64. Unsigned beta packages; macOS is not included. Automatic updates are not available. Begin with sample data and keep a separate backup.
